## Summary

This is a Spring PetClinic variant using OfficeFloor for the owner-creation pipeline. The membership tier is a **derived, read-only** value computed in the MapStruct mapper at DTO-mapping time (not stored in the DB). It is defined as a string enum (`GOLD`/`SILVER`/`BRONZE`) in `openapi.yml`, from which `OwnerDto` (and `OwnerDto.MembershipTierEnum`) are generated at build time. The test file already anticipates the target `membershipLevel` numeric field.

---

### 1. Files referencing membershipTier / membershipLevel / tier / namesakeCount / membership logic

- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java` — computes `membershipTier`, `membershipNumber`, and maps to `OwnerDto`.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` — schema defining `membershipTier` enum, `namesakeCount`, `email` (OwnerDto/OwnerFields). OwnerDto is generated from here.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` — entity with `namesakeCount`, `householdSize`, `email` fields (inputs to tier logic).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignOwnerNamesakeCount.java` — computes and sets `namesakeCount`.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignOwnerHouseholdSize.java` — sets `householdSize` (drives GOLD tier).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/NormalizeOwnerEmail.java` and `OwnerEmails.java` — email normalization (input to SILVER tier).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java` — audit logging (does NOT currently log tier).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/RespondWithOwnerCreated.java` — maps Owner→OwnerDto for the create response.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml` — the creation pipeline ordering.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java` — test referencing `membershipLevel`.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java` — test helpers.
- DB schemas define `namesake_count` / `household_size` columns: `src/main/resources/db/{h2,hsqldb,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`.

Note: no generated `OwnerDto.java` exists in the source tree — it is generated from `openapi.yml` at build time, so `OwnerDto.MembershipTierEnum` comes from the openapi schema.

---

### 2. Code that computes/assigns the membership tier

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`, lines 73–88 (the `@Mapping` binding is line 25):

75:     * household has 3 or more members (householdSize is 3+); otherwise 'SILVER' when the owner has

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner registered. Optional; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner has the same last name
            and address (i.e. they share a household). Request-only directive; not stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Server-assigned code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' - the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and a 4-digit global sequence.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Derived from the owner's own fields, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by every owner in the same household (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is created with sharesHousehold true.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created, already shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-
                Derived from the owner's own fields - 'GOLD' when the owner's household has 3 or
                more members after the owner is created; otherwise 'SILVER' when the owner has no
                namesakes (namesakeCount is 0) and an email is present, and 'BRONZE' in all other
                cases.
              type: string
              enum:
                - GOLD
                - SILVER
                - BRONZE
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, more than 80 owners had
                already been registered on the same day; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

Replaced the string membership *tier* with a numeric `membershipLevel` (1–3), computed as: start at 1, +1 if an email is present, +1 if `namesakeCount == 0`, capped at 3 (level 4 reserved for tenure).

**Changes:**

1. **`model/MembershipLevel.java`** (new) — a small single-responsibility domain helper (`MembershipLevel.of(Owner)`), mirroring the existing `Locality` helper. Encapsulates the level formula in one place so both the response mapping and the audit line reuse it rather than duplicating the rule.

2. **`mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — the `membershipTier` mapping/method (with its GOLD/SILVER/BRONZE `householdSize` logic) is replaced by `membershipLevel(Owner)` returning `Integer` (null-safe for MapStruct), delegating to `MembershipLevel.of`.

3. **`rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java`** — the create audit line now records `membershipLevel={}` (via the shared helper) instead of carrying tier information.

4. **`resources/openapi.yml`** — the `Owner` schema's `membershipTier` string enum is replaced by an integer `membershipLevel` property (which regenerates `OwnerDto` without `MembershipTierEnum`), so the response now exposes `membershipLevel` and no longer `membershipTier`.

The new `coreNumericLevel` test (owner with email + no namesakes → level 3) passes, and the audit output confirms `membershipLevel=3`.

Note: the old tier had a GOLD rule driven by `householdSize >= 3`; the new specification's formula makes no mention of household size, so that input no longer affects the level — matching the spec's "start at 1; +email; +namesakeCount==0; cap 3" exactly.
